resolution: Fixed: a painted Studio prop rendered grey in the compiled game though it showed painted in the editor/iso. Root cause was that the MESH_PROPS lump shipped the paint atlas as raw RGBA decoded from PNG at BAKE time via @reactjit/image, but the bake runs under v8cli which never registers the image-codec door (verified: __imageops_* undefined and image().raw() returns null on the actual stored paint blob), so the decode silently failed and the prop shipped untextured. Face decals/uploaded wall images worked because they decode in the Zig loader (decal_raster stbi), not the bake. Fix routes cooked-prop paint through that same working path: MESH_PROPS bumped to v4 carrying the ENCODED PNG bytes (u32 pngLen|u8[pngLen]); the bake passes the stored bytes straight through (no decode) and the loader (constructor.decodeMeshProps) stbi-decodes at load into tex_rgba. The game host already links stb (-Dhas-imageops on the app), so no v8cli rebuild. v1/v2/v3 still read for back-compat. Added a round-trip test locking the byte layout; the app build compiles (SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 rjit ship hmsc-int) and the bake runs. To SEE it: run the freshly-built host (restart the dev host / re-ship), place a painted prop, Compile, view /compiled. Couldn't self-verify pixels end-to-end because the current boot-key world has no cooked props placed.
